categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the small home appliances sector, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of products such as coffee machines, grills, irons, steam brushes, electric cookers, ovens, toasters, air fryers, and juice machine motors. It also engages in brand agency, OEM/ODM manufacturing, and coffee roasting business including innovative coffee bean flavors and drip bag products. The small home appliances segment accounts for over 96% of revenue, with the remainder from other non-small appliance products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes professional design and specialized manufacturing with advanced production processes including mold design, injection molding, assembly, testing, and packaging. It integrates new materials, energy-efficient technologies, and automation to improve production yield and efficiency. The R&D focuses on smart home appliances, IoT applications, energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies, with over 700 patents globally. The company also operates an in-house safety certification lab authorized by international bodies to expedite product certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global home appliance brands from Europe, America, and Japan such as SEB, Delonghi, Ariete, Spectrum, Conair, Sensio, and Zojirushi. The company serves end markets across the Americas, Europe, Asia, Australia, and Africa, with the Americas being the largest market. It also targets the growing Chinese and Taiwanese markets through own-brand, OEM, and brand agency sales. The coffee roasting business targets online platforms and offline retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases primarily in China (Zhangzhou and Xiamen) and Indonesia, with strategic production and sales deployment to mitigate trade tariff impacts. Its sales markets span globally including North and South America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and Africa. The company is expanding local production and market presence in Indonesia and China to diversify geographic risk and capture emerging market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions mainly as a midstream manufacturer and downstream distributor in the small home appliance industry. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers, performs R&D, manufacturing, and assembly, and sells finished products through global brand customers and distribution channels. It also engages in partial vertical integration by producing molds and some components internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in smart home appliances integrating AI, IoT, and energy-saving features, upgrading manufacturing processes with automation and green technologies, and expanding product lines with multifunctional and intelligent devices. The company focuses on strengthening strategic customer relationships, expanding emerging markets, and enhancing brand presence in Taiwan and China. R&D investments target product safety, quality, and environmental sustainability aligned with global standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of small home appliances under own brands and OEM/ODM contracts with global brand customers. Additional revenue streams include brand agency and distribution services, as well as sales from the coffee roasting business. The company also engages in import-export and wholesale trade of related products and components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive small home appliance market dominated by large international manufacturers and brands. It positions itself as a professional ODM and own-brand manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive product certifications. Its competitive advantages include cost control through manufacturing in China and Indonesia, integrated supply chain, and close collaboration with major global brand customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$7.94 billion, representing a 15% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to owners was NT$213 million, a decline compared to the prior year due to increased raw material costs and competitive pressures. The company maintains a solid financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$12.5 billion and equity of NT$6.56 billion. It continues to invest in R&D and production upgrades to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative, and energy-efficient smart home appliances that meet international safety and environmental standards. Its unique value lies in combining professional design, advanced manufacturing, and rapid certification capabilities to shorten time-to-market. The company also offers diversified product lines tailored to different consumer segments and integrates IoT and AI technologies to enhance user convenience and sustainability, thereby strengthening customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
